# Tech Genz — Software & Technology Team

> Ideas Engineered Beyond Limits.

Tech Genz is a software and technology team associated with the student community of N.B.K.R. Institute of Science & Technology (NBKRIST), Vidyanagar, Andhra Pradesh, India. The team operates independently as a student developer team aiming to turn ambitious ideas into useful digital experiences, explore emerging technologies, and build software projects.

## Identity & Disambiguation
- Brand Name: Tech Genz
- Alternate Name: TechGenz
- Role: Software & Technology Team
- College Connection: Associated with the student community of N.B.K.R. Institute of Science & Technology (NBKRIST)
- Location: Vidyanagar, Andhra Pradesh, India
- College Portal: https://nbkrist.org/
- Note: Tech Genz is formed by members of the student community; it operates independently as a collaborative student developer team.

## Motive
To use technology to solve real-world problems, encourage innovation, develop technical skills, and transform ideas into meaningful digital experiences.

## Vision
To build a smarter digital future through collaboration, continuous learning, and creative software development.

## Motto
"Ideas Engineered Beyond Limits."

## Key Projects
- SharePinz: A PIN-based ephemeral file-sharing platform (https://sharepinz.site/)
